    Induction over a preprojective component #

    Members of a preprojective component have predecessor chains of bounded length (pigeonhole with no cycles, PreprojComp.length_le), which gives induction over proper predecessors (PreprojComp.induction).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.PredN.chain {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {X : FDMod k A} {n : ℕ} {Y : FDMod k A} :
    PredN X n Y → ∃ (c : ℕ → FDMod k A), c 0 = X ∧ c n = Y ∧ ∀ (i j : ℕ), i ≤ j → j ≤ n → PredN (c i) (j - i) (c j)
